name: decode a raster image and extract pixel data in c
definition: Read a PNG image, decode it, and obtain the grayscale pixel matrix the classifier consumes.
failure_mode: Failed decode or wrong normalization shifts predictions.

name: detect takeoff and landing frame events of a running athlete in a monocular video
definition: Analyze a video of a single jump to identify the frame where the subject leaves the ground and the frame where they land, given a stationary camera and fixed scene.
failure_mode: Detected frames fall outside the accepted range on hidden videos
